target.title: feat(ui): redesign Channels page with guided channel setup wizard
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The Settings → Channels page was a wall of raw schema-driven config forms — every channel rendered every field (tokens, allowlists, JSON blobs) inline, with no guidance on how to actually connect a channel. A beginner landing on the page had no path from "I want OpenClaw on Telegram" to a working bot: the real setup knowledge (BotFather, Slack manifests, WhatsApp QR pairing) only existed in the CLI wizard (`openclaw channels add`) and the docs.

## Why This Change Was Made

Rebuilds Channels in the unified settings design language (#106470) and adds a guided, step-by-step setup wizard to the web UI — without duplicating any setup logic:

- **Gateway (additive protocol):** `wizard.start` gains `flow: "channels"` + `channel` params, routing to the shared channel-setup flow (`openclaw channels add`) over the existing `WizardSession` step protocol already used by the macOS/Android onboarding clients. The wizard branch of `channelsAddCommand` is extracted into a prompter-injectable runner (`src/commands/channels/add-wizard.ts`); the gateway entry never calls `runtime.exit`. On completion the runner reports the channels it actually configured, surfaced as an additive `channels` field on the terminal `wizard.next` result so the client keys channel-specific completion off the real outcome, not the preselection.
- **`SetupChannelsOptions.deferDeviceLinkToClient`:** gateway clients render device linking natively, so the WhatsApp finalize surface skips its terminal QR login; the Control UI runs QR pairing through the existing `web.login.start/wait` RPCs instead.
- **Control UI:** the page becomes "Your channels" (settings-language rows with 44px art tiles and dot statuses: Running / Configured / Needs attention) + "Add a channel" (guided-setup rows incl. a browse-all entry that reaches npm-installable catalog channels), following the unified settings design language (uppercase section headings, one flat group surface, hairline rows, status dots). A detail overlay keeps the full advanced surface: the migrated per-channel settings sections with live status facts, start/relink/logout actions, and the complete schema config form. The wizard modal renders the generic step vocabulary (select / multiselect / text-with-masking / confirm / note with copy button) plus per-channel helper links (BotFather, Discord developer portal, api.slack.com/apps, docs.openclaw.ai) and finishes WhatsApp setup with an embedded QR pairing phase.
- Config writes from the wizard hot-reload channels via the existing chokidar config watcher; no restart needed.

Row/cover art reuses the bundled `plugin-art` set (CSP is `img-src 'self'`, so remote brand icons can't load). The mock-dev harness gains channels/wizard fixtures so the flow is demoable and screenshot-testable offline.

## User Impact

Setting up a channel is now: open Channels → click a card → follow 2–4 short steps → done (WhatsApp ends with a scannable QR right in the dialog). All ~20 channels with setup surfaces work through the same wizard automatically, and everything that was on the old page (full config form, status detail, health JSON) is still there behind the card detail view. CLI behavior is unchanged; the macOS/Android wizard clients are unaffected (protocol change is additive).

| Channels hub | Guided setup |
| --- | --- |
| ![hub](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/channels-hub-redesign/channels-hub.png) | ![wizard select](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/channels-hub-redesign/channels-wizard-select.png) |

| Token step (masked) | Channel detail (advanced config) |
| --- | --- |
| ![wizard token](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/channels-hub-redesign/channels-wizard-token.png) | ![detail](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/steipete/openclaw-pr-assets/main/channels-hub-redesign/channels-detail.png) |

## Evidence

- Remote (Blacksmith Testbox): `pnpm check:changed` fully green (all typecheck lanes, lint, Plugin SDK API baseline, guards), `pnpm build` clean, `pnpm plugin-sdk:surface:check` green.
- Tests (Testbox): `src/gateway/gateway.test.ts` 11/11 incl. new `wizard.start flow=channels` routing + configured-channels round-trip; `src/wizard/session.test.ts`; `extensions/whatsapp/src/channel.setup.test.ts` 19/19 incl. new `deferDeviceLinkToClient` test; new `ui/src/pages/channels/wizard-controller.test.ts` (state machine: step/answer, validation errors, stale-start session cancel, gateway-reported channels).
- Protocol regenerated (`pnpm protocol:gen` + Swift/Kotlin); Swift diff is additive optional fields.
- Interactive proof: drove the mock harness end-to-end (hub → wizard select → masked token step → done; detail overlay with config form; Escape/cancel paths) — screenshots above are from that harness.
- Codex autoreview (gpt-5.5, xhigh) iterated to clean: four wizard-session lifecycle findings were fixed (disconnect leak, stale-start leak, dirty-config guard, channel attribution moved server-side); final run reported no actionable findings.
